interpretation: For fixed palettes and the constrained transport, the paper's automatic global path is exactly one affine RGB operator. Palette extraction and CPLEX select its coefficients but do not add nonlinear response. The published nonnegative row/column-sum transport constraints alone guarantee neither positive orientation nor RGB-cube range.
scope_exclusions: video interpolation beyond per-frame fixed affine form
forbidden_rescues: reimplement or tune the proprietary CPLEX stage
run the automatic global method on project images
claim the interactive local path is affine-only
add clipping or projection and call it the published method
promote the method as a film or stock learner
claim_ceiling: repeat-exact analytic and synthetic evidence about the automatic global path for fixed palettes and transport only; no claim about interactive local editing, real-image quality, film, stock, calibration or unpaired operator identification
